messages:
claire-partnerships: Quick sync — acmeHW wants to hand over SOC2 + pen artifacts early next week. We need a plan for secure ingest, redaction owners, and press embargo cadence. Who's owning transport & evidence chain? :eyes:

 dan-engineering: I can own S3 ingest pipeline but need presign policy + TTL. Are they delivering bulk .tar or separate artifacts?

 alex-sis: They're sending two things: 1) SOC2 report PDF + attestation, 2) pen-test artifacts (scan exports, logs). Prefer s3 presign per file. We asked them to split PII-containing logs.

 maria-security: @claire-partnerships + @dan-engineering — we'll require 7-day presign TTL, server-side KMS encryption, and a signed chain-of-custody doc. Jenna, legal — ok with 7-day window?

 jenna-legal: 7-day presign fine. Need explicit attestation that no customer data included. Also want to review a sample manifest before ingest.

 tyler-ops: For staging ingest: create a restricted bucket with lifecycle rule to quarantine artifacts for 30 days. We'll run automated redaction job that tags files for manual review.

 claire-partnerships: Can someone paste the presign command we expect partners to use? I'll send to Acme.

 dan-engineering: Here's a minimal presign example:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-ingest/acmehw/pen-exports/scan1.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Add content-type and kms headers in upload.

 alex-sis: Also request they include SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest PDF. We'll validate checksums on ingest.

 maria-security: Pen-test witness: do we want a live Zoom observation or recorded session? For high-risk we prefer live. @claire-partnerships thoughts for launch comms?

 claire-partnerships: Live witness for any network-level exploit demos. For press embargo: plan internal announce 48h prior, partner-only embargo + joint quote 24h prior, public announce window 2h after joint notice.

 jenna-legal: Confirming embargo windows. Also require partner to sign a press attestation doc.

 tyler-ops: I'll spin up an ephemeral workspace for the redaction review and grant access to security + legal. Naming: redwood-intake/acmehw/<ingest-id>.

 artifact-bot: ingest-ticket created: INT-4237 — owner dan-engineering, due 2026-04-02.

 claire-partnerships: Great. Action items: dan — presign + bucket config. tyler — workspace + lifecycle. maria — redaction / live-witness plan. jenna — review manifest template. Alex — confirm artifact split with Acme. I'll follow up with partner tonight. :thumbsup:

 dan-engineering: noted, will post PR for bucket IAM and presign docs by EOD.

 maria-security: I'll draft witness checklist (attack surface, allowed tools, NDA for witnesses).

 claire-partnerships: Thanks all — if nobody objects I'll ping Acme with the plan at 17:00 PT.

 alex-sis: no objections, go ahead.
